queries_run: Broadcom AVGO analyst price target consensus September 2026 Q3 earnings raise
Broadcom guidance Q4 fiscal 2026 AI revenue outlook September 2026

findings.claim: AVGO FY2026 Q3（2026-09-02 公布）營收 $29.59B、調整後 EPS $3.32，均超越財報前分析師共識（營收共識 $29.36B、EPS 共識 $3.24），為 beat-and-raise 型財報
公司財測（guidance）：Q4 FY2026 營收預期 $34.8B；AI 半導體營收預期加速至 $21.7B（yoy +236%）；FY2026 全年 AI 營收預期上修至 $58B（yoy +186%）；並首次揭露 FY2027 AI 營收指引約 $115B、FY2028 約 $230B（較 Q3 實際 AI 營收 $16.7B、yoy +221% 進一步加速）
findings.source: BigGo Finance, "[Broadcom Q3 2026 Earnings Call] AI Revenue Triples to $16.7B as Broadcom Guides FY2027 to $115B and FY2028 to $230B" (https://finance.biggo.com/news/US_AVGO_2026-09-02)

findings.claim: 財報後至查詢當下，57 位分析師目標價均值 $520.03，過去 3 個月已上修 9.34%；買進評等佔比達 84%（分析師普遍將目標價定在 numbers.price_at_dd 之上）
findings.source: ChartMill, "AVGO Forecast, Price Target & Analyst Ratings" (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/AVGO/analyst-ratings)

findings.claim: 財報後個別分析師上修目標價：BMO Capital 由 $455 升至 $575（維持 Outperform）；Cantor Fitzgerald 由 $525 升至 $600（維持 Overweight）；Raymond James 由 $450 升至 $475（維持 Outperform）——上修方向與公司上修 FY2027/FY2028 AI 營收指引同步
findings.source: Benzinga, "These Analysts Increase Their Forecasts On Broadcom Following Upbeat Q3 Earnings" (https://www.benzinga.com/analyst-stock-ratings/price-target/26/09/61600199/these-analysts-increase-their-forecasts-on-broadcom-following-upbeat-q3-earnings)

capital_markets_pricing.note: 現階段查得之目標價（均值 $520.03，個別新目標價 $475-$600）均高於 numbers.price_at_dd，且落差方向一致：財報後公司上修中長期 AI 營收指引（FY27/FY28），分析師目標價同步上修，未見下修或落後訊號。
